patthana16.80:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana16.80:2.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na sanidassanasappaṭigho na na dassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. sanidassanattika bhāvanāyapahātabbahetukaduke nasanidassanattika nabhāvanāyapahātabbahetukadukaṃ
